title: PRE-RAID: LABELS ON A DARK PILL, A BIGGER WINDOW TITLE, A QUIETER ARMOUR ROW AND BIGGER STEPPERS
why: The critic still scored the page 3 after five passes and named: map labels reading as overlapping the room blocks, the sector name outranking the window title, the armour warning as heavy as item names, ascend shown twice, and small steppers. Labels get a dark pill, the title is 32 px over a 24 px sector name, the warning is 16 px with a bar, the footer drops its ascend hint and steppers are 44 px.
now: The pre-raid page labels are easier to read, the title is bigger than the map name, and the plus and minus buttons are bigger.

edits.anchor: function put(s,x,y){ c.lineJoin='round'; c.lineWidth=2; c.strokeStyle='rgba(8,18,28,.6)'; c.strokeText(String(s).toLowerCase(),x,y); c.fillText(s,x,y); }
edits.replacement: function put(s,x,y){ var tw=c.measureText(String(s)).width, tx=(c.textAlign==='right')?x-tw:((c.textAlign==='center')?x-tw/2:x), fh=parseInt((c.font.match(/(\d+)px/)||[0,16])[1],10), f0=c.fillStyle; c.fillStyle='rgba(11,12,13,.78)'; c.fillRect(tx-5,y-fh+2,tw+10,fh+5); c.fillStyle=f0; c.fillText(s,x,y); }
